title: Dirt, Lies, and Three Ugly Faces

cards.name: ロケット団のダグトリオ (Team Rocket's Dugtrio) 083/193

junior.scene: Deep underground, beneath the northern caves of Verdant Valley, something is digging. Fast.

paragraphs.c: RUMBLE. RUMBLE. CRACK. The ground under Verdant Valley began to shake. Tiny rocks bounced across the dirt path. Then the earth split open — and three very angry heads popped out.

paragraphs.speaker: Dugtrio (Left Head)
paragraphs.c: We are on a MISSION. Keep digging!

paragraphs.speaker: Dugtrio (Middle Head)
paragraphs.c: We're ALWAYS digging. Can we take a break?

paragraphs.speaker: Dugtrio (Right Head)
paragraphs.c: No breaks! Team Rocket said find the caves. Find the caves WE SHALL.
Team Rocket's Dugtrio had a job. Sneak under the northern caves. Open a hole big enough for Genesect to slip through without being seen. Easy, sneaky, and totally against the rules.
[Underground, dirt flies everywhere as the three heads argue and tunnel closer toward the baby Pokémon hideout]
Above ground, Venusaur was RUNNING. Well, running as fast as a giant flower-dinosaur can, which is not very fast. THUD. THUD. THUD.

paragraphs.speaker: Venusaur
paragraphs.c: Why does this valley have SO MANY HILLS?!
Mismagius floated beside him, completely relaxed.

paragraphs.speaker: Mismagius
paragraphs.c: You know, I sense a dark energy below our feet. Something is digging toward the caves. Something with three opinions and zero manners.

paragraphs.speaker: Venusaur
paragraphs.c: WHAT? Why didn't you say that SOONER?!

paragraphs.speaker: Mismagius
paragraphs.c: I just did.
[The ground beneath Venusaur's left foot cracks open. A single brown head pops up and stares at him]

paragraphs.speaker: Dugtrio (Middle Head)
paragraphs.c: ...Oh. Uh. Hi. We are not digging toward any secret cave. Definitely not.

paragraphs.speaker: Dugtrio (Right Head)
paragraphs.c: SHHHH!
Meanwhile, deep in the northern caves, Charizard heard the rumbling. He spread his wings over the sleeping baby Pokémon and narrowed his eyes.

paragraphs.speaker: Charizard
paragraphs.c: ...Someone's coming through the floor. That's new.
[A tiny crack appears in the stone floor of the cave. Dust falls. The babies stir in their sleep]
To be continued...
To be continued...

full.scene: Deep underground, beneath Verdant Valley's northern caves, Team Rocket's Dugtrio tunnels toward Charizard's secret refuge — while above ground, Venusaur and Mismagius race against time.

paragraphs.c: There are things that happen underground that the sky never knows about. Deals made in the dark. Missions whispered between dirt walls. Team Rocket understood this better than anyone — which is exactly why they'd sent their most reliable asset: three heads, one body, zero conscience, and an ability called Hole-Opener that made escape routes appear like magic.
[Deep beneath Verdant Valley. The rumbling starts low — a vibration in the bones before it ever reaches the ears. CRACK. GRIND. CRACK.]

paragraphs.speaker: Dugtrio (Left Head)
paragraphs.c: Tunnel bearing north-northeast. Maintain depth. The cave system is forty meters ahead.

paragraphs.speaker: Dugtrio (Middle Head)
paragraphs.c: I just want to state, for the record, that my neck hurts and we've been doing this for six hours.

paragraphs.speaker: Dugtrio (Right Head)
paragraphs.c: Your neck is connected to MY neck. We all hurt equally. Now FOCUS.

The mission was simple, as Team Rocket missions always sounded on paper. Tunnel beneath the northern caves of Verdant Valley. Create a concealed entry point. Hold it open long enough for Genesect to pass through undetected — bypassing any warning that Venusaur or Mismagius might deliver. Simple. Clean. Ruthlessly efficient.
Above ground, Venusaur was not being efficient. He was being loud, out of breath, and deeply annoyed.
[The northern ridge trail. Venusaur's vine whips flail behind him for momentum. Mismagius glides effortlessly at his side, looking almost bored.]

paragraphs.speaker: Venusaur
paragraphs.c: I need — I need everyone to appreciate — that I am doing this for Charizard. Who has never once thanked me for anything. Ever.

paragraphs.speaker: Mismagius
paragraphs.c: He brought you soup when you had root rot last autumn.

paragraphs.speaker: Venusaur
paragraphs.c: That was ANONYMOUS soup.

paragraphs.speaker: Mismagius
paragraphs.c: I know. Isn't it sweet?
Mismagius paused mid-float. Her wide eyes darkened, the hat-like plumes along her head trembling with some invisible frequency.

paragraphs.speaker: Mismagius
paragraphs.c: ...There's something beneath us. Something that moves like intention. Three points of will, all pulling in the same direction.

paragraphs.speaker: Venusaur
paragraphs.c: In plain language, please, I'm running.

paragraphs.speaker: Mismagius
paragraphs.c: Something is tunneling toward the caves right now. Something sent by someone who doesn't want us to arrive first.

[CRACK. The ground splits between Venusaur's front hooves. Three round, pink-cheeked heads emerge from the earth like the world's least subtle surprise. Dugtrio blinks at Venusaur. Venusaur blinks at Dugtrio.]

paragraphs.speaker: Dugtrio (Middle Head)
paragraphs.c: ...We are performing routine geological surveys.

paragraphs.speaker: Dugtrio (Left Head)
paragraphs.c: Completely authorized.

paragraphs.speaker: Dugtrio (Right Head)
paragraphs.c: By us. We authorized it ourselves. Internally.

paragraphs.speaker: Venusaur
paragraphs.c: You're wearing Team Rocket colors.

paragraphs.speaker: Dugtrio (Right Head)
paragraphs.c: ...These are just our natural colors.

Mismagius let out a long, theatrical sigh. She hadn't wanted to be a hero in episode one. She hadn't wanted to be a hero in episode two. And yet here she was, crackling with psychic energy, her eyes beginning to glow.

paragraphs.speaker: Mismagius
paragraphs.c: Detain them or move past them. Choose quickly. Whatever tunnel they dug behind them — Genesect may already be inside it.

Deep in the northern caves, Charizard heard it first — not with his ears but with his feet. A low grind through the stone. A vibration that didn't belong to wind or weather. He stood slowly, careful not to wake the seven baby Pokémon curled against his tail.
His tail flame burned a shade hotter. His jaw set.

paragraphs.speaker: Charizard
paragraphs.c: ...Someone's coming up through the floor. That's a new one.

[A hairline fracture appears in the stone beneath him. Then another. The cave dust begins to drift upward — pulled by something rising from below. A Mud Shot attack's sulfurous scent drifts through the air. The babies stir. One small Larvesta opens its eyes.]
To be continued...
